reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: the live Brale SBC page still states SBC is fully backed by cash, cash equivalents, and short-duration U.S. treasuries with monthly independent AICPA attestations and lists the June 2026 report. The June 30, 2026 MCCPA report records SBC issued 9,281,937 against cash and cash equivalents $7,909,476 and U.S. government-backed debt $1,372,461 (fair value of reserves $9,281,937). Those report balances normalize to 85.21% and 14.79%. Weights updated from the prior May 31, 2026 report (70.95%/29.05%) to the latest public attestation; no invented split beyond the report line items.
